annotations.title: Multi-Domain SEO & GEO Competitor Gap Matrix

description: Build a multi-domain SEO and GEO competitive gap matrix comparing a primary domain against up to 5 competitors. Use this tool to uncover high-volume, low-difficulty keyword gaps, AI Share-of-Voice disparities, and high-converting comparison pages to publish next. Returns domain-by-domain authority metrics, missing keyword opportunities, citation gap scores, and ready-to-publish "/vs/*" page blueprints.

competitor_domains.description: List of 1 to 5 competitor root domains to compare against the primary domain.

focus_vertical.description: Market vertical or product category description used to prioritize commercial keyword gaps (default: "B2B SaaS & AI Developer Tools").

primary_domain.description: Primary root domain to benchmark against competitors (e.g., "argosor.com").

name: competitor_gap_matrix
